id: title:darkopia:default the support panel ticket list to unread

review.posthog_relevance: Adds TypeScript type definitions and state properties for ticket filtering and status management, supporting the implementation of a ticket status filter and count display in the UI.
review.reason: This chunk provides the necessary type definitions and state structure for ticket filtering and status management. While the chunk lacks the complete implementation of the filtering and sorting logic, the added types and state properties are foundational for the UI behavior described. This is a localized, bounded change supporting a specific feature implementation.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the dependent filtering and sorting, nor the complete definition of the ticket matching and activity time helpers, nor the complete view state and current ticket definitions. The P1.F3.H8 hunk relies on P1.F3.H7 and P1.F4.H1, but P1.F3.H8 also depends on P1.F3.H7 and P1.F4, and P1.F3.H8 also depends on P1.F3.H7 and P1.F4.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new selectors and the ordering and filtering logic, only the type definitions and the test assertions. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new status filter, ticket filter counts, and an effective status filter to the state.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the UI to distinguish between the user's explicit selection and the computed effective filter, supporting the dropdown and list behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a new status filter type and its labels and ordering, while changing the status filter value from a string to null and adding an effective status filter that defaults to unread or active based on unread count.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports a side panel ticket list that can switch between unread and active views, potentially improving discoverability of unread support tickets.
